reviews.t: Good addition to your hair clipping arsenal
reviews.x: For those who want to just trim the crown, this is the combo to buy. Only gave it a 4 rating since the #12 attachment really flexes and can cut shorter than expected, so don't apply too much pressure like you do with shorter attachments. The #10 flexes as well, but not nearly as much.  BOTH, however, fit a bit loose on the clipper so they rattle a bit (specially the #12)--sticking some tape on the attachment fixes this rattle. Overall, still very usable and you don't have to get a crew cut every

reviews.t: Wahl Clipper Attachments #12 And #10 Guide Combs With Flat Top Comb
reviews.x: plastic is thin and flimsy.  just have to be careful not to apply too much pressure on it while cutting.  otherwise the fingers bend a little.

I cut my own hair!  My wife  hates how my hair is always so short when I cut my hair so I bought this size 10 and 12 attachment.  I use the 10 and I'm now able to buzz the top as scissors take longer and are more difficult and my hair is turning out great!  My wife is happy now that my hair is trimmed but a bit longer than how the size 8 looked!  They seem sturdy and durable, I'm very pleased!

I have been very happy with the clipper attachments. I have used them twice so far and it has greatly reduced the amount of time that it takes me to cut my husbands hair. I use the #12 on top and #4 on the bottom. Then I just comb out the portion where they meet and snip it off with a pair of scissors to blend the two sections. Very happy with purchase.

reviews.t: Buy it from your local Beauty Supply store, the shipping is not worth it
reviews.x: Buy it from your local Beauty Supply store, the shipping on here is not worth it. I found mine at the local "Sally beauty supply store". The product itself is satisfactory. I only gave it 4 stars because the $10 shipping is ridiculous.

I have cut my own hair for 4 years using a Wahl and attachments. The #12 and #10 attachments are great as they have allowed me to keep my hair a litttle longer and not too short. I love this product!!!

After 10 years or so cutting my own hair with comb and scissors after college, I enjoyed professional haircuts for the next 40 years. Now with an unpredictably fun travel schedule, I needed haircuts at odd times & places --- so I bought the Wahl standard clipper set with a zillion combs ending at No. 8. reviews.t: Saving me tons of money on haircuts!
reviews.x: I hate going to the barber. I decided to purchase a set of Wahl clippers and start cutting my own hair. When I got the clippers, I realized the longest guide that came with them were just a bit too short for my taste. I purchased these longer guide combs, and I've been happy with both the clippers and guide combs ever since. I save a ton of money on haircuts, and I don't dread getting my haircut anymore.

reviews.t: These work great and fit most Wahl full size clippers.
reviews.x: These work perfectly on my hair.  If you take your time (as you should) and don't zip through your hair like your entering boot-camp, then these are fantastic.  Some reviewers have stated that the black comb (#12 or 1-1/2") is a bit flimsy.  Well, it's a little bit more flexible than the #10 (1-1/4") comb, but only slightly. reviews.t: Excellent for those who wish just a bit longer hair than 3/4" to 1" ...
reviews.x: If anyone has noticed, most beauty shop hair-cutters don't carry clipper attachments larger than a #6.  Some have invested in the 1-inch #8.  Nowhere have I found larger hair-cutters who own larger attachments, so I bought my own.  I'm a woman who likes my hair short and 1 inch buzzes were okay for awhile but then I decided to go just a *bit* longer ... carried my #12 guide with me into beauty shops and received the haircuts I wanted.  Nice!

reviews.t: Makes for even better at home haircuts
reviews.x: I was so glad to find out these guide sizes existed. Ordered and got them superfast. They fit our old Wahl perfectly and give the length we were looking for. With four boys/men's haircuts needed in this house, these things really save us some big bucks. We have no idea how to use the flat-top comb, but it makes for a good all-purpose haircut comb.

reviews.t: extra length is easy to get
reviews.x: Had been wanting to find these additional clipper comb attachments. Was glad to finally find them. They work great helps to get cuts done easy and quickier. Good product. Anything to save time. Thanks
Searched for a very long time to find just 1 or 2 combs that would keep my long haired dogs at a reasonable length; especially in the winter months. These are perfect!

reviews.t: Great to Have; Plastic Could be Slightly More Rigid.
reviews.x: I've been cutting my own hair for the last decade, but I've always been constrained to a hairstyle that's an inch or less long. I wanted longer hair and considered giving up the self-cuts and going to a professional, but I enjoyed having consistent, free-of-charge haircuts with no wait.  These attachments have helped immensely. I can leave my hair up to 1.5" long on top with no problem. The only disadvantage is the semi-flimsy plastic. You just have to make sure that you don't apply force at an

reviews.t: good for the length, bad for the quality
reviews.x: The good:  These fit my Wahl clippers just right.  The lengths are perfect for what I am personally looking for, with leaving the top of my hair longer than the sides. Obviously check the lengths of these for what you'd want your hair to be at. I cut my own hair so these work perfect for what I want.  The comb is fine to be added in, but I feel like if you already have Wahl clippers, you probably should already have a comb. But it's a neat addition.  The bad:  The shorter guide is white, so the

I purchased a couple of the larger ones - I think they were the 1.5 and 1.25" and as stated by others, they are a bit flimsy but work well for me. I hop in the shower (NO water on), trim my hair (I just keep running the larger one over my head until I feel all the hair is the same length, brush myself off, carefully get out, clean up the hair and shower. Works for me.

As a balding man, I don't see the point of visiting some place to have my hair trimmed. However the default longest guards that came with my clippers still weren't quite long enough. This set solved that problem.  They are a lot flimsier than the guards in the standard set, but they get the job done.

These seem to be of decent quality and work just as expected. They do seem to be a bit over priced for a couple of pieces of plastic, but the are Wahl brand, and the first time you use them they pay for themselves. They work well on both my son's and my hair.

The #10 guide works great, saves me the trouble of cutting the "top" of my head with scissors. If I lost it, I'd buy another right away. They #12 works just as good too, just don't like my hair that long on top.

These combs are made of very thin plastic. They are narrow in width and extremely flimsy. Save your money and don't purchase them! In addition, the sender was very slow but, made claims it was due to a postal error.

From what I can tell, the #12 is the longest available. Both the #10 and #12 are longer than any of the guards included with my clipper. They are more flimsy than the stock ones for sure, but they get the job done.

reviews.t: A must have in a house full of just boys!
reviews.x: My wife cuts our boys, and my hair. These bigger sizes are indispensable when trying to achieve the cuts & styles in todays world. The set length, makes it easier to keep the cut uniform & neat. A must have.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these longer #10 and #12 attachments for enabling longer haircuts and faster, easier at-home clipping.
Several reviewers complain that shipping costs are excessive relative to the low item price, and suggest buying elsewhere.
Multiple reviewers note the plastic combs are thin and flexible, with the #12 flexing enough to cut shorter than expected if too much pressure is applied.
Some reviewers highlight that these attachments fit Wahl clippers well and fill a gap since larger sizes are hard to find locally.
